name: Analytic-Splatting Forward Shading
definition: Computes the 2D Gaussian signal response for a pixel by performing eigendecomposition on the covariance matrix, rotating the coordinate system to decouple axes, and applying a conditioned logistic function to approximate the pixel area integral of the Gaussian CDF.
summary: Analytic-Splatting Forward Shading computes 3D Gaussian color by analytically integrating over pixel areas to provide anti-aliased results with higher detail fidelity than Mip-Splatting.
